subject.title: fix(security): add ReDoS guard to exec approval argPattern matching

question: What canonical Doctor remediation should OpenClaw apply to existing persisted exec-approval entries whose `argPattern` is now rejected as unsafe?
rationale: The runtime must not execute unsafe regexes, but choosing whether Doctor removes, disables, or requires explicit operator replacement of a formerly matching approval is a security-policy and upgrade-contract decision.

options.title: Add Doctor detection and explicit remediation
options.body: Have Doctor identify every unsafe persisted pattern and require an explicit, documented remediation rather than leaving the upgrade failure to runtime.

options.title: Auto-remove unsafe approval entries
options.body: Make Doctor --fix remove entries with unsafe patterns, preserving fail-closed security but requiring users to re-create intended approvals.

options.title: Land runtime rejection only
options.body: Accept that existing affected approvals fail only at execution time without a migration path.

recommendation.title: Add Doctor detection and explicit remediation
recommendation.body: Have Doctor identify every unsafe persisted pattern and require an explicit, documented remediation rather than leaving the upgrade failure to runtime.
